Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different historical figures named “Anna of Hungary.” He assumed that Andronikos II’s wife (Anna of Hungary, the Byzantine empress) was the daughter of Béla IV and Maria Laskarina, which actually describes Anna of Hungary, Duchess of Macsó. The correct mother of Anna of Hungary (Byzantine empress) is Elizabeth the Cuman (wife of Stephen V). This misidentification led to the wrong maternal grandmother being concluded as Maria Laskarina instead of Elizabeth the Cuman, despite later WebSurfer results correctly indicating Elizabeth the Cuman.
